title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Introduction
Wilfrid Laurier University is a full member of
Universities Canada (The Association of Universities and Colleges of
Canada), the Association of Registrars of the Universities and Colleges
of Canada, The Association of Commonwealth Universities, and the
American Association of Collegiate Registrars and Admissions Officers
.
The Senate and the Board of Governors of Wilfrid
Laurier University reserve the right to make changes in this calendar without prior notice.
